REHEARSED on 2026-10-27 on vc's order, read-only, and vc accepted both. REFERENCE, at cb664a6c5: BASE=`git describe --tags --abbrev=0` is v3.2.6; gen_reference.sh `--rev HEAD --baseline v3.2.6 --out <dir>` and gen_cut_surface.sh `--rev HEAD --baseline v3.2.6 --out <dir>/cut-surface.md` both exit 0 with no note, warning or error; reference_current_check.sh exits 1, stale as expected, since the committed set describes bdc841bef against v3.2.5; 21 pages change and intent-estate.md is new; beyond the baseline's move the register adds `intent install` and `intent use`, the estate family's page, and `wb archive`'s positional renamed to id; cut-surface.md lists 13 commands and 26 flags newer than v3.2.6. SHOTS, on fc5931c44 in molt-vc's cargo slot 01M5YZKPJR7V1E18PE0ED87GQF: gen_explorer_shots.sh built cold into tmp/target-ic-shots (in-tree, ignored, never native/rust/target) and exited 0 in 88 s; 9 of 11 PNGs are byte-identical, and menu.png and help.png change with the /estate view; docs/explorer.md's prose already covers /estate. AT THE RELEASE, at the content batch's HEAD: regenerate both halves into scratch and read the diff; copy them over docs/reference with cp, never rsync -a, which skips a same-size regenerated file; git add intent-estate.md; re-run the shots with the default --out in a cargo slot and read `git status -- docs/images/explorer`; one commit carries the reference set and the changed PNGs; then reference_current_check.sh exits 0, before the kovacs preflight. The cut runs from the banked scripts refs/bank/ic/tools/hold12-cut-measure-v2.sh (a7c158237103), hold12-cut-shots.sh (4b5623c131ba) and hold12-cut-apply.sh (27b11a348aa7), dry-run three times to exit 0.
